## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4008. The issue was caused by the ingress controller upgrade enabling `allow-snippet-annotations=false`, which disabled the `configuration-snippet` annotation previously used for regex-based redirects. The ingress controller logs clearly showed the annotation being skipped with a warning. The legacy-portal backend service is healthy, confirming the issue is with the ingress configuration. I've documented the root cause, provided evidence from the logs, and outlined three possible fixes for the platform team to implement.
